superagent.patch_note: Windows, lifecycle and API-budget patches: accept a drive-letter absolute stateDir; filter the router tool restriction to tools the profile actually has; write worker CLI shims as .cmd files on Windows; close the issue that started a ticket when its pull request merges; look ten minutes back on every notification poll; poll closed threads for 48 hours instead of 14 days and skip per-thread reads when fewer than 300 API calls remain. The process also needs Git for Windows' usr/bin and bin on PATH.
